label: Folk Metal / Heavy Metal fusion with traditional Chinese influences

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solemn, meditative atmosphere that evokes ancient spirituality, which is abruptly shattered by an explosive transition into high-octane aggression.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars playing fast, palm-muted riffs and power chords form the core harmonic structure from the first heavy beat until the outro.
